job.title: Development Project Manager
job.description:
DEVELOPMENT PROJECT MANAGER | WATERFALL WAY COMMUNITY LAND TRUST

About Waterfall Way Community Land Trust

Too many of the people who keep our communities running can no longer afford to live in them. Waterfall Way Community Land Trust is doing something about it.

Waterfall Way is a community-led not-for-profit bringing a housing model with more than 50 years of international history to the NSW Mid North Coast. Buyers pay for the value of the home, Waterfall Way contributes the value of the land, and a cap on resale prices keeps the homes affordable for future buyers.

Ferry Street in Urunga is Waterfall Way’s demonstration project. It will create permanently affordable homes for at least six local households. This will be a downpayment on the target of 100 homes in ten years and show how other Australian communities could do the same. Funding is committed, and Council has resolved to transfer the land subject to conditions.

The opportunity

As Development Project Manager, you’ll take Ferry Street from concept to handing over the keys. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll work with the project committee and Board to guide the development and assess other sites as opportunities arise.

  • Lead the Ferry Street demonstration project from concept to handover, creating homes for at least six eligible households, with priority for local workers on moderate incomes. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll work with the project committee and Board and assess other land opportunities as they arise.
  • Lead master planning and the NSW development application, and coordinate site investigations, design and specialist consultants.
  • Manage the project budget, cash flow, schedule and risks. Set out options for the CEO, project committee and Board.
  • Test construction methods, lead the builder tender and administer the contract through handover and defects.

About You

You’ll bring construction or residential development experience, with examples of projects you’ve taken from concept and documentation through to delivery. You’ll know the NSW planning approvals process and be comfortable managing budgets, tenders, consultants and builders.

Experience in regional NSW, affordable housing or modern methods of construction is welcome.

Why join Waterfall Way Community Land Trust

You’ll join a small, community-led organisation at a point where your experience can shape how it delivers its first homes. The decisions you help make at Ferry Street will inform Waterfall Way’s future developments and help show how other Australian communities could use the model to make home ownership permanently affordable for locals.
